visual_review.identity: Muted ochre/copper-brown blunt-lobed leaf groups over dark warm brown earth with sparse gray stones and a few blunt twigs. Leaf-litter dominant rather than the previous needle/twig-stroke variant.
visual_review.style_review: Approximately ten to fourteen broad leaf groups including clipped edge groups, with large low-contrast open soil areas. Leaves have broad matte planes, few center-fold marks, and no vein networks. Ground still has subtle cloudy texture and more secondary patch contours than the strict six-to-ten-plane prompt.
visual_review.palette_caveat: Additional olive-green leaves are more prominent than the original brown-dominant source, although ochre/copper-brown remains the main identity. Exact color/leaf-species recovery is not claimed.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Main groups about220-350 native pixels, about45-71 world units at256; individual lobed leaves can be12-25 units. Review with actual mask/world sampling before binding.
visual_review.native_acceptance: Opaque catalog-only native candidate; no natural seamlessness or actual-scene acceptance claimed.
